newsitem.title: USA: Eagle Pacific says purchases fuel Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Pacific says purchases fuel Q4 gain.

text.p: Eagle Pacific Industries Inc said Thursday the addition of two plastic producers in mid-1996 helped the company post a profit in the fourth quarter ended December 31 versus a loss a year ago.
The company reported net income of $288,628, or $0.02 a share, compared to a loss of $199,205, or $0.05, in 1995.
Sales in its traditionally weakest quarter decreased to $12.8 million from $14.0 million in the fourth quarter one year ago, the company said.
Eagle Pacific, a maker of plastic tubing and pipe products, said it believes the sales deficit will recover in the first quarter of 1997, which ends March 31.
Its shares were off 1/16 Thursday at 3-3/8.
